name: Zrain Image Tools
description: Browser image editing, compression, AI background removal, OCR, previews, conversion, cropping, watermarking and art. The AI model downloads on first use; images remain on your device.
note: Publish each website to its own real address, then add the verified URL to Zrain Ecosystem admin. Draft until live functionality is checked.

name: Zrain PDF Tools
description: Free, browser-first tools for merging, splitting, rotating, cropping, rearranging, extracting text and rendering PDF pages, as well as adding text and watermarks. Cropping is not redaction; existing PDF text is not directly rewritten. Some features fetch third-party libraries on first use.
note: Publish each website to its own real address, then add the verified URL to Zrain Ecosystem admin. Draft until live functionality is checked.

name: Zrain Document Tools
description: Convert supported PDF, DOCX and image formats, and clean CSV data. Preview converted files where supported. Complex document layouts may differ.
note: Publish each website to its own real address, then add the verified URL to Zrain Ecosystem admin. Draft until live functionality is checked.

name: Zrain Developer Tools
description: Free browser utilities for JSON, Base64, local JWT decoding, SHA checksums, UUID generation, CSS shadow previews, Markdown, QR codes, passwords and UTM links. JWT decoding does not verify signatures.
note: Publish each website to its own real address, then add the verified URL to Zrain Ecosystem admin. Draft until live functionality is checked.

name: Zrain Productivity Tools
description: Simple invoices, text utilities and a basic teleprompter. No account needed. The teleprompter does not support remote control, recordings or voice-follow.
note: Publish each website to its own real address, then add the verified URL to Zrain Ecosystem admin. Draft until live functionality is checked.
